summary: Iteration-19 verified the checkout fix (shipping.full_name+phone now sent), locale persistence, per-country couriers, DSK bank details, single name field with validation, 90-day localStorage memory, multilingual transactional emails (all 11 storefront locales render + send via Resend), abandoned cart capture/upsert/recovery, and the smaller homepage heading. Backend: 45/45 pytest cases pass in test_iteration19_checkout_emails.py — POST /api/checkout returns 422 when shipping.full_name or shipping.phone is omitted, 400 when terms_accepted=false, 200 with full payload; the created order document persists the 'locale' field ('ro' verified via direct Mongo read since the admin _order_view intentionally strips locale). /api/nextcart/config returns the correct courier set per country with EUR currency and cod as payment_methods[0]; /api/bank-details returns DSK Bank / BG61STSA93000032400775 / STSABGSF / Purepeptide LTD; /api/nextcart/countries returns 11 countries with default=BG and Bulgarian names. POST /api/cart/track upserts a single 'open' record per email; empty items returns 400. Admin GET /admin/abandoned-carts lists carts, POST /admin/abandoned-carts/{id}/send returns sent flag, POST /admin/abandoned-carts/sweep runs. POST /admin/emails/test renders order + abandoned templates for all 11 locales (bg,en,fr,de,cz,hu,pl,sk,si,gr,ro) without a 500 and Resend actually delivers (sent:true for the required locales). Placing an order for an email with an open cart marks that cart 'recovered'. Frontend (Playwright on the public preview URL): full order placement (add to cart → tick terms → checkout → fill single pc-name='Иван Петров' + pc-email + pc-phone → search 'София Аксаков' in pc-pickup-search → pick office → pc-continue) succeeds and lands on /checkout/success/{id} with NO 'Field required' error — this was the iteration-18 blocker and it is fixed. pc-continue is disabled with a 1-word name and enabled only when name has ≥2 words + valid email + phone ≥6 digits + pickup selected. Courier sub-labels 'до офис' / 'до кутия' / 'до адрес' are rendered under Econt / BoxNow / Pigeon logos. Payment section lists COD first & pre-selected, pc-bank-details is hidden until pc-payment-bank_transfer is chosen and then shows DSK Bank + BG61STSA93000032400775 + STSABGSF + Purepeptide LTD. Country switch: DE→GLS (2 methods, 8,99 €, COD default), RO→FAN Courier, GR→Speedex — all in EUR. Pigeon fragmented street search 'София Иван Вазов' returns 5+ Sofia Ivan Vazov streets with NO 'София — София' duplication. Econt 'София' office search returns top-5 all starting with 'София'. 90-day memory: pre-seeded pp_checkout_v1 (name/email/phone/methodKey='boxnow_locker'/provider='boxnow'/payment='bank_transfer') is fully restored after reload — name+email+phone repopulated, active_courier=pc-courier-boxnow, pc-payment-bank_transfer checked. Homepage 'Пептиди, изследвани за:' renders at 20px (text-lg sm:text-xl) and layout is not broken.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _order_view intentionally omits the 'locale' field, so admin/orders GET does not surface which language the customer used. That is a pure data-projection choice, but if the merchant wants to resend a confirmation in the customer's language from the admin panel it should be added to the projection.

abandoned.py sweep() compares `cart.created_at` (a datetime) against `order.created_at` (stored as ISO string via server.py L741) using an inequality — the ISO-string branch works because order.created_at is stored as a string, but a stray datetime document would break the comparison. Consider normalising storage.
nextcart.py COURIER_FALLBACK GLS price is a hard-coded 8.99 € (all fallback GLS countries show '8,99 €'). For HU/PL upstream shows lower real prices — worth moving to env or DB so ops can tune.

PreCheckoutModal.jsx placeOrder falls back to postal_code='0000' when a courier office has no postal_code — could fail GLS/DE 5-digit validation later; safe today because all tested offices had a postal_code but keep in mind.

PreCheckoutModal.jsx keeps only 1 open cart per email but sends /cart/track on every 1.5s debounce for every keystroke burst — fine given upsert semantics, but each save writes a full snapshot; adding an ETag/hash to skip unchanged writes would cut Mongo traffic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — full e2e order placement, 90-day memory, country switch, sub-labels, bank details, relevance ranking, fragmented search, homepage heading all verified

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created ~3 orders and ~15+ abandoned carts prefixed with TEST_iter19_* for the checkout / upsert / recovery / multilingual-email flows. Frontend Playwright created 1 real order (customer_email=TEST_iter19_ui@example.com) via COD that landed on /checkout/success/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything requested for iteration-19 is verified end-to-end. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration19_checkout_emails.py (45 tests, ~21s). Key testids: precheckout-modal, precheckout-close, pc-name (single field, placeholder 'Име и фамилия'), pc-email, pc-phone, pc-country, pc-dial, pc-couriers, pc-courier-{econt|boxnow|pigeon|fancourier|speedex|gls}, pc-method-*, pc-pickup-search, pc-pickup-results, pc-city, pc-street, pc-street-results, pc-number, pc-postal, pc-payment-cod (default), pc-payment-bank_transfer, pc-bank-details, pc-discount-code, pc-discount-apply, pc-total, pc-continue, cart-terms-checkbox, cart-checkout-btn, cart-button. localStorage key for 90-day memory: pp_checkout_v1 (with saved_at ms timestamp, TTL 90 days). Multilingual template locales: bg,en,fr,de,cz,hu,pl,sk,si,gr,ro. CZ/IT genuinely have no GLS pickup upstream — address-only there is expected.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — the iteration-18 shipping.full_name+phone omission bug is fixed in PreCheckoutModal.placeOrder (L434-441) and end-to-end order placement now returns 200 + navigates to /checkout/success/{id}.
